title: Baked plums with oat and almond crumbs

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Plums, oats, almonds, sugar, oil, lemon and cinnamon are all ordinary cupboard and garden things.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream supermarket in late August.

basic_kitchen.reason: Only a baking dish, a bowl and a knife are needed, and the technique is simple.

works.reason: Eight plums with a 60g oat and 40g almond topping makes a fair snack for four, and 200°C for 20 to 25 minutes will soften the plums and brown the crumbs.

honest_times.reason: Stoning eight plums, chopping a handful of almonds and mixing the topping fits in 10 minutes, and the 25 minute cook matches the bake.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Late August is the height of the British plum season, and the plums are clearly the point of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are plain, clear British English a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is fruit with oats and nuts and only modest sugar, a real-food snack a family would happily make again.
